intro:
Can you spot every trace?
Choose it, erase it
A dark mystery puzzle
description:
What would you remove from the scene to keep the truth from coming out?

This is a mystery puzzle game where you recover the evidence left behind at a scene and aim to make the case impossible to solve.

You are not the detective. You are an evidence cleaner, hired by the culprit to wipe away the traces they left behind.
Read the prompt, study the illustration, and find the evidence that needs to disappear.

How to play:
・Read the case prompt
・Observe the illustrated scene
・Select the matching piece of evidence

Choose correctly, and that item vanishes from the scene.
Look for footprints, belongings, objects and suspicious details, then remove the clues that could work against your client.

Every request and every case has its own circumstances.
Each scene asks you to decide what should be erased, testing both your observation and deduction skills.
With bite-sized questions, it is easy to play in short sessions while still enjoying a satisfying think.

Recommended for fans of mysteries, deduction, illustration-spotting and brain-teasing puzzles.
Collect every piece of evidence and lead the case into the dark.

Button and touch controls are supported.
